message.reasoning_content:
I need to revise page 4: reduce empty space in cards. Increase vertical distribution: enlarge numbers, move labels/English ghost text lower or distribute evenly, compress card heights.

Current layout: stats at top 322, height 198; roles at top 562, height 344; footer bottom 44.

Total available height: header ends ~290. Footer at 1080-44. So area from 300 to ~1010 = 710px. Currently stats 198 + gap 24 + roles 344 = 566... wait stats top 322, roles top 562, so gap = 562-322-198 = 42. Roles end at 906. Footer at ~1036. So there's ~130px empty bottom.

Better: make cards use flex column with justify-content:space-between, heights adjusted. Let me redesign:

- head top 132, h1 66px → header rule at 290.
- stats: top 322, height 200, three cards, use flex column: label top, number centered, ghost bottom-right.
- roles: top 552, height 400, cards with flex column space-between: num top, tag, h3, p at bottom.

Let me compute: 322+200 = 522. gap 30 → roles top 552, height 400 → end 952. Footer at bottom 44 → footer text at 1080-44-18 ≈ 1018. Leaves gap of ~66. Good.

Actually maybe make roles height 410 and end at 962. Fine.

For vertical distribution inside cards, use display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between.

Stat card: height 200 with padding 26/34. Elements: label (16px), value (num 96px). Distribute: label at top, value centered, ghost at bottom right. Use flex column justify-content:space-between with value aligned to bottom-ish.

Let me design stat:
```
.stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:28px 34px 26px;height:200px}
.stat .label{...}
.stat .value{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px}
.stat .num{font-size:104px;line-height:.85}
.stat .unit{font-size:26px}
.stat .ghost{position:absolute;right:26px;bottom:20px;...} 
```
But if ghost is absolutely positioned bottom, and value also near bottom, they'd overlap. Better: put ghost in flow after value? Let's restructure: label top, then value in the middle-bottom, ghost as separate line? Hmm.

Alternative: place ghost text at top-right of card (aligned with label row), and value at bottom. That gives good vertical distribution: label top-left, ghost top-right, big number bottom.

Actually reference had ghost bottom-right. To avoid overlap, put ghost text right-aligned at top row as small caption. But better keep visual language: label left top, English caps label to the right of the same row (muted small letterspaced) — that's fine and not "invented content" since it's just English translation already present in the current version (INVITATION, GROUPS, DURATION). Keep them.

So:
Row 1: label + English tag (space-between).
Row 2 (bottom): big number + unit.

Then card content spans full height with space-between. Good.

Stat height: maybe 210. With num font 104 → line .86 ≈ 90px. Row1 ~22px. padding 30+28 = 58. Total 22+90+58 = 170, plus space-between gap. Set height 210.

Hmm 322+210=532, gap 28 → roles top 560, height 400 → 960. Footer at 1018. ok.

Role cards: height 400, flex column, padding 30 30 28.
- num (38px display) + tag row? Currently num then tag. Put num top-left and dot top-right.
- h3 name (36px) 
- p description at bottom with more line-height.

Use justify-content:space-between with three blocks: (num+tag) block, h3, p. Or distribute: top block, middle h3, bottom p. That fills nicely.

Let me write:

```
.role{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;height:400px;padding:30px 30px 30px}
.role .top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
.role .num{font-size:42px}
.role .tag{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:3.4px}
.role h3{margin:0;font-size:38px;line-height:1.15}
.role p{margin:0;font-size:20px;line-height:1.75}
```

With justify-content:space-between and 3 children, gaps distribute extra space. Height 400 - padding 60 = 340 content. Content heights: top row ~44, h3 ~44, p ~35 (single line) → 123; extra 217 split into 2 gaps of ~108 each. That might be too airy. Hmm, that's opposite of compression. Maybe better: reduce role card height to 340 and keep p near bottom.

Actually the request: "提高信息在卡片内的垂直分布（放大数值字号、将说明与英文标签下移或居中分布、适当增加行距），或压缩卡片高度使版面更紧凑". So either spread out or compress. Best: compress card heights so page is balanced, and use space-between distribution moderately.

Let's design roles height 360:
- padding 32 30.
- content: top row (num 42 + tag) ~46; h3 38*1.15 ≈ 44; p 20*1.8=36 (multi-line for long ones: "分组体验带队与任务说明配合" at 20px in a ~410px wide card → likely 1-2 lines). Cards width: (1768 - 3*24)/4 = (1768-72)/4 = 424. minus padding 60 = 364. "分组体验带队与任务说明配合" 13 chars * 20 = 260, fits on one line. "按 9 项反馈问题记录使用问题" fits too.

So content ≈ 46+44+36 = 126, extra 360-64-126 = 170 → 2 gaps of 85. Reasonable, gives airy but structured layout. Maybe reduce to height 340 → gaps 75.

Let's compute total: stats top 322 height 210 → 532; gap 28; roles top 560 height 348 → 908. Then footer 1018. Gap 110 empty bottom still. Hmm. Better to fill more: make roles height 400 → ends 960. Gap to footer ~58. That's fine.

Let's go with stats height 216, roles top 566... Let me recompute cleanly.

Layout plan:
- top-rule 48, head 132 (kicker 14px, h1 66px). Head block: kicker at 132 (~20px tall), h1 margin-top 18 → starts 170, height ~74 → ends 244. head-rule at 290. ok keep as is.
- stats top 318, height 212 → ends 530.
- roles top 558, height 402 → ends 960.
- foot-note bottom 44; page-no bottom 40.

Empty space between 960 and ~1010: 50px. Good.

Stat card inner: height 212, padding 30 34 28 → content 154. Row1 ~22, value ~92 → 114; space-between gives 40 gap. Good distribution.

Now numbers: font-size 110 for "84" — width fine. Let's use 108px with line-height .85 → 92px tall.

Ghost/tag placement: top-right, small, letter-spacing.

Also maybe add a thin baseline rule inside stat card between label and value for visual structure. Keep it simple.

Role card: add a horizontal hairline above the description? That could add structure. Maybe a subtle divider between h3 and p. Let's keep: top row (num + tag), then h3 name aligned center-left, then p at bottom. Add small dot at top right? The tag already there.

Let me write the CSS carefully.

```
.stats{position:absolute;left:96px;top:318px;width:1768px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:26px;z-index:12}
.stat{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;height:212px;padding:30px 34px 28px;background:...;border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.14);overflow:hidden}
.stat:before{top:0;left:34px;width:52px;height:3px}
.stat .row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
.stat .label{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--theme-muted)}
.stat .ghost{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3.2px;color:rgba(27,38,32,.28)}
.stat .value{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px}
.stat .num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:108px;line-height:.86;font-weight:700}
.stat .unit{font-size:26px;font-weight:600;color:var(--theme-muted);letter-spacing:1px}
```

Wait the accent top bar overlaps padding top 30, fine.

Role cards:
```
.roles{position:absolute;left:96px;top:558px;width:1768px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:26px;z-index:12}
.role{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;height:402px;padding:32px 30px 30px;border-top:2px solid var(--c);background:...;border-left/right/bottom...}
.role .top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between}
.role .num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:46px;line-height:1;font-weight:700;color:var(--c)}
.role .tag{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3.4px;color:var(--theme-muted)}
.role h3{margin:0;font-size:40px;line-height:1.12;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
.role p{margin:0;font-size:20px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--theme-muted);letter-spacing:.2px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.12)}
```
Hmm the p with border-top adds a divider — nice structure, and padding-top increases occupation. But with space-between, p block at bottom.

Content heights: top 46, h3 45, p 36+17=53 → 144. Content box 402-62=340 → extra 196 → 2 gaps of 98. That's a bit much. Reduce role height to 380? 380-62=318, extra 174 → gaps 87. Still airy but acceptable as "提高信息垂直分布" which is what they asked (spread). Alternatively increase font sizes of p and h3.

Let me increase: h3 42px, p 21px line-height 1.85. And maybe add a small descriptive line? No, can't add content.

I'll set roles height 396 and roles top 558 → end 954.

Actually, let's also make the roles grid taller by giving more vertical rhythm: card height 396.

Check: 558+396 = 954. Footer at ~1018. fine.

Vertical gaps: content 396-62 = 334; blocks: top ~48, h3 ~47, p ~39+17=56 → 151; extra 183 → 2×91.5. OK visually fine — three tiers spread across card.

Alternatively distribute with three gaps: use justify-content:space-between which gives exactly 2 gaps. Fine.

Let me also reconsider: is having such large gaps good design? It reads as a structured "top: index/tag, middle: role name, bottom: description". That's acceptable and matches the instruction "将说明与英文标签下移或居中分布".

Now also ensure the footer note and page number unchanged.

Also keep the ghost English labels: INVITATION, GROUPS, DURATION — these are in the current version, retaining them is fine (not new facts).

Let me write final HTML.

Head: keep same.

One more: the `.head h1` font-size 66 with "资源安排｜名额、分组与四类岗位" — sub at 52px. Width check: 66*4=264 + sep + 52*11=572 → total ~900, fits in 1500. Good.

Add subtle bottom accent? Keep.

Write out.
